feed.title: HAX Element Schema
feed.subtitle: Documentation for HAXElementSchema, the lightweight virtual DOM object format HAX uses before converting to real DOM nodes.

entry.title: Overview
entry.content:
HAXElementSchema is the lightweight object format HAX uses as a virtual DOM representation before converting to real DOM nodes.

This is a companion spec to hax-schema. Where hax-schema explains the full haxProperties contract for element authoring, this site focuses specifically on the element payload objects used in demoSchema, insertion, and conversion workflows.

Core shape

HAXElementSchema is an object with this shape:

Field reference

  • tag (required): HTML/custom-element tag name to create.
  • properties (optional): key/value map of attributes and/or properties.
  • content (optional): string content assigned as light DOM.
  • eventName (optional): event metadata added by insertion pipelines.

entry.title: Virtual DOM Usage Points
entry.content:
HAX uses the HAXElementSchema object shape as a lightweight virtual DOM payload during authoring operations. The object is passed around, transformed, and only materialized into actual nodes at insertion/render time.

These are the primary usage points in HAX core:

Virtual DOM → DOM conversion

haxElementToNode(haxSchema) creates real nodes from tag, properties, and content.

Reference: elements/utils/utils.js#L1207-L1314

DOM → virtual DOM conversion

nodeToHaxElement(node, eventName) serializes existing nodes into HAXElementSchema.

Reference: elements/utils/utils.js#L1500-L1718

Prototype/factory creation

haxElementPrototype(gizmo, properties, content) returns { tag, properties, content, gizmo }.

Reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#L5102-L5109

Tray insertion pipeline

hax-tray resolves demoSchema[0] or builds a prototype object and dispatches it via hax-insert-content.

Reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-tray.js#L1081-L1136

Store insertion pipeline

_haxStoreInsertContent consumes detail.tag/content/properties and converts to DOM via haxElementToNode for inline and replace flows.

Reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#L4067-L4192

Keyboard shortcuts

Shortcut map entries are HAXElementSchema-style objects and are converted to nodes at runtime.

References:

  • elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#L2975-L2985
  • elements/hax-body/hax-body.js#L1852-L1878

Duplicate workflow

haxDuplicateNode converts DOM → HAXElementSchema → DOM to ensure clean cloning.

Reference: elements/hax-body/hax-body.js#L2426-L2443

Dev helper insertion

globalThis.Hax.add inserts using schema.demoSchema[0] via haxElementToNode.

Reference: elements/hax-body/lib/hax-store.js#L5348-L5355

entry.title: Runtime Behavior & JSON Schema
entry.content:
Runtime conversion behavior

In HAX core, conversion happens primarily in two functions:

  • haxElementToNode(haxSchema) — converts a schema object to a real DOM node.
  • nodeToHaxElement(node, eventName) — converts a DOM node to a schema object.

Important behavior to be aware of:

  • Camel-cased property keys are converted to dash-cased attributes where needed.
  • true sets boolean attributes, false removes them.
  • Object/array values are set as properties when possible.
  • content becomes light DOM (innerHTML) on conversion.
  • iframe is rewritten to webview in sandboxed environments.

JSON Schema

This spec includes a machine-readable JSON Schema, hax-element-schema.schema.json, for validation and tooling support against the repository source.

Why this exists

  • Keep HAXElementSchema documentation focused and easy to discover.
  • Provide canonical examples for docs, tests, and tooling.
  • Offer a shared reference for systems that import/export HAX element payloads.

entry.title: More Schemas
entry.content:
hax-element-schema is one of several schema specifications in the HAX ecosystem. Explore the others:

  • JSON Outline Schema — the content structure, site navigation, and metadata schema used by HAXcms.
  • HAX Schema — the full haxProperties contract for element authoring.
  • Merlin Schema — the command-palette and voice-assistant Option/Program schema.
  • Appstore Spec — the schema for external media providers, upload targets, stax templates, and autoloaded elements.
